firstone-framework.name: FirstOne Framework
firstone-framework.side.client.tooltip: Changes only your own game. Set here, works on every server, even servers without the mod.
firstone-framework.side.server.tooltip: Changes game rules run by the server. Set here for singleplayer; a server with the mod uses its own files in config/firstone-framework/.
firstone-framework.config.reset.title: Reset %s?
firstone-framework.config.reset.message: Every option on this screen goes back to its default value.
firstone-framework.config.server_notice: Server rules: changes apply to singleplayer only
A dedicated server uses its own file: config/firstone-framework/%s
firstone-framework.animatium.name: Animatium
firstone-framework.animatium.old_sneak.t: 1.7.10 sneaking: the hitbox keeps its full height (no walking under 1.5-block gaps) and the eyes drop only slightly, with 1.7.10 timing. The crosshair always aims where the camera looks.
firstone-framework.animatium.old_item_dr: 1.7.10 dropping: the arm never swings, and dropping the last item lowers it and raises the empty hand.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_reeq: 1.7.10 held item: no dip after attacking, and no re-equip when only the durability of the held item changes.
firstone-framework.animatium.old_item_us: 1.7.10 right-click: no arm swing when throwing or using items (ender pearl, egg, snowball...) or right-clicking entities. The hand only dips when the item count changes.
firstone-framework.animatium.no_sweep_ef: Hides the sweep attack particle and mutes the sweep sound (added in 1.9). Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.no_damage_i: Hides the dark heart particles shown when hitting a mob (added in 1.9). Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.no_attack_s: Mutes the player attack sounds added in 1.9 (crit, strong, weak, knockback, no damage, sweep). Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_enti: 1.7.10 movement of other entities: positions snap to 1/32 block and only update after moving 0.125 block or turning 5.6 degrees, velocity only updates after changing by 0.02, and heads turn instantly. This is the stepping look of 1.7.10. Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_body: 1.7.10 body turning: players and old-AI mobs turn sideways when walking backwards and can look up to 75 degrees away from their body. Other mobs use the 1.7.10 body helper. Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_snea: 1.7.10 sneaking model: shown whenever shift is held (also while flying), only the legs and head move, and the model is lowered like 1.7.10.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_zomb: 1.7.10 arms: zombies and skeletons always hold their arms straight forward (skeletons point the bow forward instead of only aiming when attacking), with the 1.7.10 attack swing.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_mob_: 1.7.10 client physics: mobs are also moved by your client with their own velocity, so getting hit, knocked back or pushed looks jerky like 1.7.10 instead of gliding smoothly. Works on any server.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_hurt: 1.7.10 hurt color: hurt and dying entities, armor included, get the bright 1.7.10 red (40% red at block brightness, not darkened by night). Held items and blocks stay untinted, as in 1.7.10.
firstone-framework.animatium.legacy_mob_: 1.7.10 mob attacks: mobs only swing their arm when they hold an item, so an empty-handed zombie does not raise its arms when it attacks. Works on any server.
firstone-framework.appearance.name: Appearance
firstone-framework.appearance.icon.toolt: Click to switch between Minecraft's icon and the PNG files in the icons folder.
firstone-framework.appearance.icons_fold: Put PNG files in config/firstone-framework/appearance/icons/ and reopen this screen to see them.
firstone-framework.appearance.window_tit: Text of the game window title. Leave empty for Minecraft's default title.
firstone-framework.appearance.confirm_qu: Ask before the window's close button (X) quits the game. Cancel is the default answer, so Enter or Esc keeps playing. The in-game Quit Game button never asks.
firstone-framework.legacy_hud.name: Legacy HUD
firstone-framework.legacy_hud.descriptio: 1.7.10 HUD: no effect icons in the corner
firstone-framework.legacy_hud.hide_effec: No effect icons in the top-right corner, like 1.7.10. Effects still work and are still listed in the inventory.
firstone-framework.combat_tweaks.name: Combat Tweaks
firstone-framework.combat_tweaks.descrip: Pre-1.9 combat: no attack cooldown, no sweeping
firstone-framework.combat_tweaks.no_atta: Every hit deals full damage right away, like before 1.9: no waiting for the attack cooldown.
firstone-framework.combat_tweaks.disable: Attacks no longer damage entities around the target, like before 1.9.
firstone-framework.combat_tweaks.sweepin: Sweeping still works with a Sweeping Edge weapon. Only used while Disable Sweeping Attack is on.
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.name: Legacy Mechanics
firstone-framework.legacy_mechanics.lega: 1.7.10 knockback when hit: players get the full knockback (1.21 loses about half of it), always pushed 0.4 up (also in the air), knockback resistance is a chance to ignore knockback, arrows push away from the shooter, and creeper/TNT explosions also knock back.
1.7.10 extra knockback from players and mobs: sprinting always adds knockback (no full charge needed), applied as a push with 0.1 upward motion, not reduced by knockback resistance.
1.7.10 sneaking on the server: crouching players keep the full 1.8-block hitbox and 1.62 eye height. Players without the mod cannot crouch into 1.5-block gaps.
